title: When the Recipe Wakes
author: S. M. Vasquez
blurb: Odile Nystrom, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
